entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. I've been meaning to call.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the order number?

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. So, to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. I tried to return it weeks ago, but your site wasn't working.
Okay, I understand. Can you tell me more about that? When you say the site wasn't working, what happened?
It was a total website error. The whole returns page was just blank. The whole system was down, I guess. I couldn't print a label or anything. I even took a screenshot.

I appreciate you explaining that. Let me check our internal logs for that timeframe... Yes, it looks like we did have a known service outage that affected the returns portal around December 24th. I do apologize for that inconvenience.
Let me just check the return policy for the item. One moment please... Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window.

Yes, absolutely. Given the circumstances with our system outage and that you're within the policy timeframe, I can go ahead and email you a prepaid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
The email has been sent. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good rest of your day.
